- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised on factors to consider when choosing a power adapter:
  - Compatibility with UK's voltage (230V, 50Hz)
  - Number of devices to charge
  - Size and weight of the adapter
  - Reviews and ratings from other customers
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reminded the user to pack necessary converters or transformers for their devices.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information about Edinburgh's weather:
  - Daytime temperatures range from 8°C (46°F) in winter to 18°C (64°F) in summer.
  - Average of around 170 rainy days per year.
  - Windy conditions, especially in winter.
  - Average of 1,500 hours of sunshine per year.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended packing essentials for Edinburgh's weather:
  - Waterproof jacket or coat
  - Insulating layers (thermal base layers, fleeces, sweaters)
  - Warm socks and gloves
  - Scarves and hats
  - Waterproof trousers
  - Comfortable shoes
  - Compact umbrella
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for packing clothing items that can be layered and mixing and matching outfits.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised on notifying bank and credit card companies about travel plans:
  - Log in to online banking or mobile app to notify banks and credit card companies.
  - Notify at least 1-2 weeks before the trip.
  - Include all accounts that will be used abroad.
